_comment: Copy to the project folder as project.json and fill it in. Keys starting with _ are notes. The sessions folder comes from TABULA_SESSIONS (.env); a "sessions" key here overrides it.
title: Band name
subtitle: Venue · Town · 1 janvier 2027
_lang: the chapters' and titles' words: en (Chapters, GREETINGS, BAND INTRODUCTION, THANKS, INTERMISSION, (encore), Part 2) or fr; "labels" overrides any of them
_foh: the stereo the audience heard: two card tracks, and the matrix pair they come from (null when they are Main LR itself)
_outputs: other matrix pairs fed by the main mix, drawn with a meter computed from the FOH tracks
_inputs: omit to show every channel with a recorded track plus every named channel sent to LR that was on at some time
_input_tracks: channel → card track, only when tabula's track names do not match the channel names
_fx: the effects shown; send_bus: the bus feeding it, send_track: the card track recording that bus (the strip's meter)
_delay_fx: the effect whose first parameter is a delay time in ms: its tempo is drawn, and its changes said as tempos
_dca_hidden: DCAs not shown (a calibration group, say); unnamed DCAs are never shown
_voices: the singers' mic tracks: Whisper listens to them, and an a cappella start is found on them
_onsets: card track → dBFS RMS above which it is playing (DIs low, mics that hear the talk high or left out)
_spoken: how the chat names a strip, by its scribble name (default: 'Vx Name' → "Name's voice", else 'the <name>')
